load_govreport_dataset: load the ccdv/govreport-summarization dataset from Hugging Face for long context testing
extract_reports_from_dataset: extract report text from each item in the dataset test split
format_conversation_messages: format each report into a human conversation message asking for a summary
build_conversations_list: build a list of conversation objects from all reports in the dataset
write_conversations_to_json: write the conversations list to a JSON file with 4-space indentation
